preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string in the input has length between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for s in strings for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the strings are lowercase letters.
The number of questions Q is between 1 and 500000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= n for L, R, _ in questions)
preconditions.description: For each question, L and R are integers such that 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(q_str) <= 10 for _, _, q_str in questions)
preconditions.description: The query string in each question has length between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for _, _, q_str in questions for c in q_str)
preconditions.description: All characters in the query strings are lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(str(count) for L, R, q_str in questions for count in [sum(1 for s in strings[L-1:R] if q_str in s)]) + ' ' if Q > 0 else ''
postconditions.description: For each question (L, R, q_str), the output is the count of strings in the range [L, R] (1-based) that contain q_str as a substring, separated by spaces.
